description:
Discover the epitome of Mediterranean luxury at Vission Hills, an exclusive gated residential development perfectly situated in the highly sought-after destination of La Cala de Mijas on the Costa del Sol. This premium development offers an exceptional collection of 162 contemporary apartments in phase one ranging from one to three bedrooms, alongside just 18 luxury semi-detached 4 bedroom with private swimming pools. Designed to blend seamlessly with the natural coastal landscape, the architecture features clean lines, balanced proportions, and a modern yet timeless aesthetic that maximizes natural light and breath-taking, elevated views of the Mediterranean Sea.

Every property within Vission Hills is crafted with a meticulous selection of premium materials and high-quality finishes, presenting a sophisticated and functional layout. The open-plan kitchens flow effortlessly into the main living spaces, serving as a bright and practical heart of the home. Expansive windows connect the interiors to generously proportioned, private terraces that act as true outdoor rooms, allowing residents to embrace outdoor living and the region’s incredible climate all year round. The bedrooms are conceived as spacious, light-filled retreats of calm and privacy, while the bathrooms are designed as true wellness sanctuaries complete with large-format finishes, designer sanitary ware, and soft, layered lighting.

Living in this secure community provides access to a wealth of first-class shared amenities designed to enhance your everyday wellbeing. Residents can unwind in the integrated swimming pools, relax in the beautifully landscaped Mediterranean gardens, or disconnect in a private spa sanctuary. For active and professional lifestyles, the development features a fully equipped, bright fitness space, a versatile residents’ lounge ideal for socializing, and an inspiring, ergonomic co-working space that supports a perfect work-life balance.

Beyond luxury and comfort, Vission Hills represents a smart and sustainable investment. Built with an exceptional Energy Rating A, these low-energy buildings feature high levels of thermal insulation, individual air source heat pump systems, and controlled mechanical ventilation. This advanced eco-friendly design delivers lower carbon dioxide emissions and up to an estimated eighty-five percent energy savings, significantly reducing annual running costs.

The prime location in La Cala de Mijas offers an unparalleled balance of tranquility, privacy, and exceptional connectivity. Residents are only a short distance from the beach and world-class golf courses, such as La Cala Golf, Calanova Golf, and Miraflores Golf. Fast access to the AP-7 and A-7 transport links ensures you are just eight minutes from Fuengirola, twenty minutes from Málaga International Airport, and twenty-five minutes from the vibrant heart of Marbella. Vission Hills presents a rare opportunity to secure a home that perfectly resonates with balance, convenience, and an elevated quality of life.
